question: How many executions will be carried out in the US in 2026?

calls.reasoning: As of Oct 7, 2026 there had been 30 executions, with 9 more scheduled Oct 13-Dec 31 (39 if all proceed). Not all scheduled executions happen (Texas, Ohio and Tennessee dates fall through more often; Tennessee is under review after the Pike failure), so I expect about 7 of 9 to proceed. Florida, which executed 19 in 2025 and 13 by mid-Aug 2026 and gives about 30 days notice, will probably add 2-3 late-Nov/Dec executions not yet on the list. Nidal Hasan's military execution on Dec 3 counts under the fine print, but it is the first military execution since 1961 with livestream-related legal questions; about 45%. Expected total is about 40-41, SD about 2, with the most weight on the upper end. Live research tools failed this run, so the evidence is thin, and no human market was found or searchable.

calls.reconciliation: All three runs agreed on 30 executions done and 9 scheduled (39 if all go ahead), on the ~30-day Florida warrant lead time and on Hasan's Dec 3 date. They differed on three factual points (whether Hasan is among DPIC's 9, the state mix and Tennessee exposure of the 9, and whether Florida dates exist past mid-November) and on judgment calls about stay rates and Hasan's odds. I tried to check these (DPIC upcoming list via WebFetch, Hasan status via WebSearch, DPIC page via curl). All failed: the API error on search and fetch, and the curl needed approval. So no factual dispute was settled. On judgment: I take ~80% completion of the 9 (Run 3's attrition rate), Florida +2 (all runs agree on the mechanism, and the 2026 pace supports it), and Hasan at ~50%, likely not in the 9 because the fine print calls out military executions specifically. That gives a mean of ~40.3, SD ~2, which lands between Run 2 and Run 1. I agree with the runs' reference class and carry it forward.
